Renderer.Quality.note: Overall graphics preset shown in the menu.

Renderer.Quality@Variant0.note: Overall graphics preset shown in the menu.

Renderer.ResolutionScale.note: Render resolution scale. Higher looks sharper but costs FPS.

Renderer.VSync.note: Vertical sync. Off reduces input lag but may tear.

Renderer.FramerateCap.note: Maximum FPS. Match it to your monitor refresh.

Renderer.ShadowQuality.note: Shadow resolution. A common FPS saver when lowered.

Renderer.AntiAliasing.note: Anti-aliasing method used by the renderer.

Renderer.AmbientOcclusion.note: Ambient occlusion adds contact shadows at a GPU cost.

Renderer.MotionBlur.note: Motion blur. Competitive players usually disable it.

Renderer.DepthOfField.note: Depth of field blur in menus and killcams.

Renderer.FilmGrain.note: Film grain overlay. Visual only, disable for clarity.

Renderer.LensFlare.note: Lens flare effect on bright lights.

Renderer.ViewDistance.note: How far the world draws in full detail.

Graphics.FOV.note: Field of view. Wider sees more but shrinks targets.

Graphics.ADSFOV.note: Whether aim-down-sights keeps the wide FOV.

Graphics.HDR.note: High dynamic range output on supported displays.

Display.NVIDIAReflex.note: NVIDIA Reflex low-latency mode on supported GPUs.

System.ThreadCount.note: Worker thread count. Leave at your CPU thread count.

System.MemoryBudget.note: Memory budget in MB for asset caching.

System.CPUAffinity.note: CPU core affinity mask. Changing it can hurt scheduling.

System.BackgroundFPS.note: FPS cap while the game is not focused.

System.ShaderPreload.note: Preload shaders at startup to avoid mid-match stutter.

System.DiskCache.note: On-disk shader and asset cache size in MB.

System.CrashDumps.note: Write crash dumps for support tickets.

Streaming.OnDemand.note: Download high-detail textures on demand while playing.

Network.Rate.note: Network update rate. Higher is smoother on good connections.

Network.Port.note: UDP port used for match traffic.

Network.PacketBurst.note: Packet burst smoothing for jittery connections.

Audio.MixPreset.note: Audio mix tuned for headphones or home theater.

Audio.HRTF.note: Spatial audio positioning on stereo headphones.

Hidden.DebugOverlay.note: Internal debug overlay. Not in the in-game menu.

Hidden.FPSCounter.note: Hidden FPS counter outside the menu options.

Hidden.ConsoleEnabled.note: Developer console flag. Not in the in-game menu.

Hidden.SkipIntros.note: Skips studio intro movies at startup.

Hidden.UploadLogs.note: Automatic log upload after a crash.

Hidden.ConfigVersion.note: Internal config schema version. Editing it can reset your settings.

Hidden.ProfileChecksum.note: Integrity checksum for the profile. The game rewrites it.

Hidden.LastServer.note: Last connected server address, cached by the game.

Hidden.AsyncCompute.note: Async compute queue toggle for testing.

Hidden.ScreenshotFormat.note: Screenshot file format used by the photo mode.

Hidden.SafeMode.note: Forces safe-mode defaults on next launch when true.

Hidden.LegacyInput.note: Legacy input path for old controllers.

Hidden.RawMouse.note: Raw mouse input bypassing OS acceleration.

Hidden.MouseSmoothing.note: Mouse smoothing. Competitive players disable it.

Hidden.ControllerDeadzone.note: Stick deadzone override outside the menu range.

Hidden.StreamerMode.note: Hides name and IP details for streaming.

Hidden.ModSupport.note: Mod loading support flag. Unsupported by the publisher.

Hidden.SecretSauce.note: Unknown internal value. Leave it alone.

Renderer.SecretSauce.note: Unknown internal renderer value. Do not modify.

System.SecretSalt.note: Unknown internal system value. Do not modify.
